wagmor.label: Wagmor Pets
wagmor.evidence: https://www.wagmorpets.org/available-dogs/ - 'View available dogs below, then click the blue button to fill out an adoption application.' https://www.wagmorpets.org/adoption-application/ - 'There are several steps in this form. You must complete all steps to submit your application.' Seven sections, from About You through References. No email address is published anywhere on the site: https://www.wagmorpets.org/contact-us/ is a web form with an 'Adoption Questions' category, alongside a phone number (818-691-3466) and the shelter address, 11939 Ventura Blvd, Studio City CA 91604. Verified 2026-07-29.

muddypaws.label: Muddy Paws Rescue
muddypaws.evidence: https://www.muddypawsrescue.org/adopt - 'Only fully registered adopters can email us to schedule a meeting.' Registration form linked as 'register to adopt'; mailto:adoptions@muddypawsrescue.org published for questions/registration issues; registered adopters email adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org to schedule a meeting with a specific dog.

animalhaven.label: Animal Haven
animalhaven.evidence: https://animalhaven.org/contact-us - 'If you'd like to learn more about a specific animal, please fill out our Adoption Interest Form.' https://animalhaven.org/adopt/adoption-process - Step 1 is an in-person visit; the interest form 'is not an application and is not a requirement to meet our animals'; the real adoption application is filled out on site. info@animalhaven.org appears in the site-wide footer (mailto link).

waggytail.label: Waggytail Rescue
waggytail.evidence: https://www.waggytailrescue.org/adopt-a-waggytail - 'If you're interested in adopting a Waggytail, please submit an application form.' 'Dog Adoption Application' links to the Petstablished form above (published link also carried an fbclid tracking param, stripped). Email adopt@waggytailrescue.org from https://www.waggytailrescue.org/adopter-faq - 'Still have questions? Reach out to our adoption team at adopt@waggytailrescue.org'

sugarmutts.label: Sugar Mutts Rescue
sugarmutts.evidence: https://www.sugarmuttsrescue.com/sugar-mutts-rescue/how-to-adopt/ - 'you can download our adoption application below and email it back to us at sugarmuttsrescue@gmail.com'. Also https://www.sugarmuttsrescue.com/contact/ - 'You can email us at sugarmuttsrescue@gmail.com ... Feel free to contact us about anything... boarding a horse, adopting, fostering...'

seancasey.label: Sean Casey Animal Rescue
seancasey.evidence: https://www.nyanimalrescue.org/adopt - 'If you'd like to inquire about one of our dogs, email adopt@nyanimalrescue.org, or call us at 718-436-5163.' Confirmed on https://www.nyanimalrescue.org/contact which lists adopt@nyanimalrescue.org among department addresses. No online adoption application published; process is in-person at 153 East 3rd Street, Brooklyn.

koreank9.label: Korean K9 Rescue
koreank9.evidence: Site is behind Cloudflare (403 to direct fetch; not bypassed). Confirmed via https://www.adoptapet.com/shelter/94459-korean-k9-rescue-long-island-city-new-york (lists applications@koreank9rescue.org and the application URL https://www.koreank9rescue.org/adoption-application/) and via web-search results indexing koreank9rescue.org pages, which state applications take 7-14 days and to follow up at applications@koreank9rescue.org if no reply after 14 days. Email is a follow-up channel, not the first step.

nycsecondchance.label: NYC Second Chance Rescue
nycsecondchance.evidence: Every one of their Petstablished listings closes with 'The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website' and cites https://nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-adoption-application/ (26/26 dogs on page 1; resolves 200, titled 'Dog Adoption Application'). The older /general-application/ link that appears in some write-ups now 301s. Email rescue@nycsecondchancerescue.org is the address the rescue publishes in its own Petstablished organization record (shelter 83716). 501(c)(3), EIN 26-4835303, PO Box 570701 Whitestone NY 11357.

loveleo.label: Love Leo Rescue
loveleo.evidence: https://loveleorescue.org/ - nav item 'ADOPTION APPLICATION' links straight to the Petstablished adoption form above (form_id=36515); their own /adopt page is the Wagtopia widget and renders nothing without JavaScript. The site's dog list embeds wagtopia.com/search/org?id=2349259, which confirms the org_id this source reads. No email address or phone number is published anywhere on the site: https://loveleorescue.org/contact is a web form - 'Questions? Please fill out the contact form below. As a small team, we appreciate your patience. Please allow 24-48 hours for a reply.' Note the domain is .org; loveleorescue.com has no DNS record at all. 501(c)(3), EIN 47-4175366, Los Angeles CA. Verified 2026-07-29.

apurposeful.label: A Purposeful Rescue
apurposeful.evidence: https://apurposefulrescue.org/faq - 'You must start by filling out an adoption application.' No application link is published anywhere on the site to go with that sentence: both https://apurposefulrescue.org/adopt and /adoptable-dogs are Shelterluv embeds (shelterluv_embed.js, GID 609) and neither the pages nor the nav carry an application URL, and there is no contact page at all - apurprescue@yahoo.com is the only address published. The apply_url above is therefore their Petstablished form, adoption_form_id 53142, which is identical on all 53 of their listings and is what those listings' own adopt buttons open; it returns 200. Note the split: their own site sends adopters to Shelterluv, while LUVD reads their Petstablished roster (org 3204319) - see sources/rescues/apurposeful.py. 21 of those 53 records are courtesy posts for other organisations and are dropped rather than attributed here. Los Angeles CA. Verified 2026-07-30.

animalrescuemission.label: The Animal Rescue Mission
animalrescuemission.evidence: https://www.theanimalrescuemission.org/adopt is a Petstablished embed and the page carries org id 2330596, which is what confirms the org_id this source reads rather than taking it from the directory on trust. Their nav links /adoptionapplication on their own domain (also Squarespace, also Petstablished-backed), which is preferred over the raw Petstablished form because it is the link the rescue would give an adopter themselves. info@theanimalrescuemission.org is published on the site. 501(c)(3) founded 2018 by Shira Scott Astrof; a Best Friends Animal Society network partner, which is the outside corroboration that this is a working rescue. West Hollywood CA - all 19 of their listings say so. Verified 2026-07-30.
